name: smda-automation
description: Tier-3 setup skill for State-Machine-Driven Automation, packaged for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold a repo's SMDA config against the SMDA Scheduler product.
interface.longDescription: Installs or refreshes a repo-local SMDA operating model (config, routing, gates) wired to the SMDA Scheduler product hosted in this repo. Config surface only: it never vendors engine, adapter, schema, or report code into the target repo.
defaultPrompt: Set up SMDA automation in this repo against the SMDA Scheduler product.
Refresh the SMDA config and check it against the product contracts.
